{{Nickname}}
A [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who used the pseudonym "'''WompRat'''" worked out of a base in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], during the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were a subscriber to, and commenter on, [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]].<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref> In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], WompRat commented on the entry for the [[XL-Lioness]] [[TDL nanny droid]] stating that the security of the droid's processors were easy to bypass. WompRat's brother's children had managed to use a [[Computer probe/Legends|computer probe]]&mdash;supplied by WompRat&mdash;to insert programming routines into their [[Nanny droid/Legends|nanny droid]] that allowed them to stay up late.<ref name="CDD">[[Star Wars Adventure Journal 14|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 14]]</ref> Two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, WompRat complained about the number of [[ASP-7 labor droid/Legends|ASP-7 labor droids]] present in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]],<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref> and commented on the entry for the [[CLL-8 binary load lifter]] that [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] used the same [[Binary/Legends|binary]] [[Language/Legends|language]] that was used in [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|moisture vaparators]]. As a result, [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] tended to scavenge programming modules from vaporators to repair damaged [[Load lifter (machine)|load lifters]].<ref name="CDD" />
